title: QuickBooks and Mailchimp now work in Perplexity Computer | QuickBooks blog
summary: Manage cash flow, chase overdue invoices, and track Mailchimp marketing campaigns directly inside Perplexity Computer with Intuit's new AI integration.
body_markdown:
Now, answers to your business questions can be grounded in trusted, real-time data, intelligence, and action from Quickbooks and Mailchimp.


## How it works


One in three businesses report lack of integration between tools and systems, creating inefficiency, according to the most recent


[Intuit QuickBooks Quarterly Insights Survey](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/r/small-business-data/small-business-insights/) . With this integration, QuickBooks and Mailchimp work directly within Perplexity Computer, so businesses can go from answers and insights to action without missing a beat.


When a user authenticates with their existing QuickBooks or Mailchimp account, their data is accessed through Intuit's trusted platform, using Intuit's established security, privacy, and compliance controls. This


**enables secure execution of complex, high-stakes financial insights and actions within their Perplexity Computer interface** . Starting today, the new QuickBooks and Mailchimp experiences are available to users in the US directly within Perplexity Computer.


All Intuit products, including its embedded AI-powered platform experiences, are built with Intuit's strong commitment to data privacy, security, and responsible AI governance. Intuit implements technical and organizational safeguards to help protect customer data and privacy using industry-leading technology and practices.


## Getting started


Bringing QuickBooks and Mailchimp directly into Perplexity Computer bridges the "insights-to-action" gap. It’s another example of Intuit meeting customers where they are to deliver trusted financial experiences at scale directly inside the AI platforms people already use every day.


**Ready to try it? Connect your account today:**


- [Connect QuickBooks in Perplexity Computer](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=quickbooks)
- [Connect Mailchimp in Perplexity Computer](https://www.perplexity.ai/computer/connectors?connector=mailchimp)
